grant title: U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) Rural Energy for America Program (REAP) Renewable Energy Systems & Energy Efficiency Improvement Guaranteed Loans and Grants
acronym definition: REAP = Rural Energy for America Program; USDA = U.S. Department of Agriculture
funding agency/organization: U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) Rural Development
brief description: Provides grant funding and guaranteed loan financing for rural small businesses and agricultural producers to install renewable energy systems or make energy-efficiency improvements.
eligibility notes: Potential fit for rural breweries, brewpubs, and beverage manufacturers with qualifying energy projects such as solar, refrigeration, Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning (HVAC), boilers, lighting, or process efficiency.
matching requirement: Generally required; percentage varies by project and funding type
application deadline: Grant applications not currently accepted; guaranteed loan applications may be submitted
application cycle: Pending new U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) guidance/regulatory changes
additional notes: 2026 official update: U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) is not accepting new Rural Energy for America Program (REAP) grant applications under the rescinded Fiscal Year (FY) 2025-2027 Notice of Funding Opportunity (NOFO); guaranteed loan applications may continue. Confirm before presenting grant availability to users.

grant title: U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) Rural Business Development Grants (RBDG)
acronym definition: USDA = U.S. Department of Agriculture
funding agency/organization: U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) Rural Development
brief description: Provides grant money to assist with economic development planning and/or the financing or expansion of rural businesses.
eligibility notes: Funds generally go to eligible public bodies/nonprofits/tribes rather than directly to businesses; breweries may benefit through local revolving loan funds, technical assistance, incubators, or community projects.
additional notes: Track state Rural Development (RD) office notices and intermediary RLFs.

grant title: U.S. Small Business Administration (SBA) 504 Loan Program
acronym definition: SBA = U.S. Small Business Administration
funding agency/organization: U.S. Small Business Administration
brief description: Long-term fixed-rate financing for major fixed assets that promote business growth and job creation.
eligibility notes: Strong fit for breweries purchasing land, buildings, construction, renovations, or large equipment through CDC/lender structure.
matching requirement: Borrower contribution commonly required; structure varies
interest rate: Fixed; set by market/SBA debenture terms
industry focus: Small business fixed assets; manufacturing; hospitality
additional notes: Excellent fit for brewery buildouts, real estate, and equipment.

grant title: U.S. Small Business Administration (SBA) 7(a) Loan Program
acronym definition: SBA = U.S. Small Business Administration
funding agency/organization: U.S. Small Business Administration
brief description: SBA-guaranteed loans for most business purposes including working capital, equipment, expansion, real estate, and business acquisition.
eligibility notes: Broad fit for startup or existing breweries depending on lender underwriting and U.S. Small Business Administration (SBA) eligibility.
application cycle: Rolling through U.S. Small Business Administration (SBA) lenders
additional notes: Use as baseline national loan product.

grant title: Economic Development Administration (EDA) Public Works Program
acronym definition: EDA = Economic Development Administration
funding agency/organization: U.S. Economic Development Administration
brief description: Supports distressed communities to revitalize, expand, and upgrade physical infrastructure to attract industry, encourage expansion, and create/retain jobs.
eligibility notes: Usually applicant is public/quasi-public entity; breweries may benefit indirectly through industrial sites, downtown districts, utility upgrades, or redevelopment infrastructure.
additional notes: Indirect but high value for brewery clusters and redevelopment districts.

grant title: Economic Development Administration (EDA) Economic Adjustment Assistance Program
acronym definition: EDA = Economic Development Administration
funding agency/organization: U.S. Economic Development Administration
brief description: Flexible Economic Development Administration (EDA) program supporting technical, planning, public works, and infrastructure assistance in regions experiencing economic changes.
eligibility notes: Indirect fit when brewery/manufacturing/tourism development is part of a regional economic recovery or redevelopment strategy.
additional notes: Important for local governments/EDOs supporting brewery-related redevelopment.

grant title: Federal Historic Rehabilitation Tax Credit
acronym definition: None
funding agency/organization: Internal Revenue Service / National Park Service
brief description: Federal tax incentive for rehabilitating qualifying historic income-producing buildings; generally equal to 20% of qualified rehabilitation expenses.
eligibility notes: Strong fit for breweries, brewpubs, or taprooms redeveloping certified historic industrial/commercial buildings.
additional notes: Often stackable with state historic credits and local redevelopment incentives; requires specialized tax counsel.

grant title: Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Brownfields Multipurpose, Assessment, Cleanup, and Revolving Loan Fund Grants

eligibility notes: Indirect fit for breweries redeveloping former industrial sites; usually applicant is municipality, redevelopment authority, tribe, or eligible nonprofit.
additional notes: Track local Revolving Loan Fund (RLF) subrecipient opportunities.
